name: journzey-ai
description: journzey.ai — Institutional Trading Journal & AI Discipline Terminal

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web,admin -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @journzey/api" "npm run dev -w @journzey/web" "npm run dev -w @journzey/admin"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @journzey/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @journzey/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @journzey/api && npm run build -w @journzey/web && npm run build -w @journzey/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:shared && npm run db:migrate -w @journzey/api
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:shared && npm run db:seed -w @journzey/api
scripts.admin:create: npm run build:shared && npm run admin:create -w @journzey/api --
scripts.admin:reset-password: npm run build:shared && npm run admin:reset-password -w @journzey/api --
